_comment: 'reference_audio' is the SIM reference: a HELD-OUT recording, i.e. not the
file the voices were cloned from.
'texts_file' points to a JSON file with {"texts": [{"text": "..."}, ...]}.
Real/personal texts live under data/ (gitignored) rather than inline here,
since this testset.json is a tracked, already-pushed file.
The *_voice_id fields are optional: without them the runner falls back to
'impostor_audio' is a file or glob of a DIFFERENT speaker. It gives SIM its
lower bound: without it, a similarity of 0.60 cannot be told apart from
'this metric returns 0.60 for any two German voices'. A handful of Common
Voice DE clips is enough. Measured upper bound on this material (the same
speaker across two real recordings): SIM median 0.79, range 0.67-0.86.
